title: HydroSAVER WaterSense Water Conservation Kit (Showerhead + 3 Aerators)

comparisons.notes: PF WaterWorks HydroSAVER kit with identical contents: 1.5 GPM 3-spray showerhead, 1.5 GPM swivel kitchen aerator, 2x 1.0 GPM bath aerators

writeup: PF WaterWorks' HydroSAVER kit bundles a WaterSense 1.5 GPM three-pattern showerhead, a dual-spray swivel kitchen aerator and two 1.0 GPM bathroom aerators, all with brass fittings. It's a cheap way to cut water use across a whole house. Home Depot sells the same kit for $17.68.
